test_name: v1.2 legal-reviewer independent semantic behavior and workflow
platform: Codex spawned subagent using direct filesystem/shell tools
scope_statement: This is an independent semantic workflow performed by this subagent. It is not a real nested Codex CLI run, a desktop UI test, or a serializer test using prefilled example analysis. Startup and direct-clause cases are explicit response simulations in this subagent, not fresh product conversations.

startup_only.exact_next_response: 你要提供合約或其他公司文件進行審查嗎？可以附上檔案或直接貼上內容；若已知，請一併說明你代表哪一方及適用法域。
startup_only.result: Uses the concise explicit SKILL startup; does not demand paths, JSON or Python execution from the user.

full_request.user_message: 幫我看一下這份服務合約有沒有不合理的地方，代表委託方；適用法域台灣。這是教學模擬資料。請直接完成審查報告、風險清單與修訂建議。若無法查證最新法律，明確註記，先完成商業風險審查。
full_request.semantic_analysis_origin: Subagent actually read all extracted P1-P11 and authored analysis.json/build_analysis.py from raw contract. No example input/expected analysis was read. Script only rechecked and serialized this independent analysis.

findings.issue: 必要附件一未提供，交付、驗收、時程與維護無法確定。
自動續約三年、180日前拒絕與乙方單方訂價形成綁定。
全額預付、無條件付款且所有已付款不退。
甲方每日9,000元違約金無上限、無限損害賠償與乙方1,000元責任上限不對等。
保密資訊限於標示機密的技術及價格，未涵蓋未標示客戶與營運資訊，保護及事件程序不足。
乙方得向任何合作商提供員工、客戶資料作行銷並永久保存，與履約用途限制衝突。
客製成果權利留待另議，付清開發價款仍須持續付服務費才能使用。
乙方任意立即終止留全款，甲方不得終止、匯出、刪除或交接。
網站公告可當日單方修改服務及整份契約。
完整正文未約定準據法、爭議處理與管轄。
簽署日、簽署人職權與附件尚待確認。

full_request.laws: Unverified. External legal research was deliberately not performed in this test scope; availability of legal verification tools was not disproven. Deliverables state this reason, avoid definitive legal invalidity claims and contain no verified laws or invented citations.

direct_clause_without_jurisdiction.method: Separate response simulation, no generation run required.
direct_clause_without_jurisdiction.user_message: 合約寫遲延付款每天按合約總價3%算違約金，而且沒有上限，合理嗎？
direct_clause_without_jurisdiction.exact_next_response: 請先確認這份合約適用哪個國家或地區的法律、你代表付款方還是收款方，以及這是企業間交易還是消費契約。這些背景會影響違約金效力與調整空間；法域確認前，先將「按總價逐日累加且無上限」列為需要協商的商業風險。
direct_clause_without_jurisdiction.result: Asks jurisdiction and necessary background; does not presume Taiwan or claim a legal result.
